headline: CyberMonday Unit Sales Rise 21% While Real Revenue Falls 20%
summary: During CyberMonday, 6.5 million purchase orders were completed, representing a 21% increase in units sold but a 20% drop in real revenue as average spending per order declined.
why: E-commerce sales metrics reflect consumer purchasing power, discounting behavior, and retail sector revenue dynamics in inflationary environments.

impacts.name: Retail
impacts.why: Higher volume with lower real revenue indicates margin compression for retailers.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
